Brad Feld - Partner at Foundry | LinkedIn ## About Brad Feld has been an early-stage entrepreneur and investor since 1987

He co-founded two venture capital firms, Foundry Group and Mobius Venture Capital, as well as multiple companies, including Techstars

Brad is a writer and speaker on venture capital investing and entrepreneurship and has written several popular books, including Venture Deals and Startup Communities

He runs the Anchor Point Foundation with his wife, Amy Batchelor
